literal: Shengzong, Part One
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part One

literal: Emperor Shengzong Wenwu Daxiao Xuan, taboo name Longxu, childhood name Wenshunu.
idiomatic: The Emperor Shengzong, posthumous title Wenwu Daxiao Xuan, personal name Longxu, childhood name Wenshunu.

literal: Eldest son of Emperor Jingzong; his mother was Empress Ruizhi of the Xiao clan.
idiomatic: He was the eldest son of Emperor Jingzong; his mother was Empress Ruizhi, née Xiao.

literal: From childhood the Emperor loved writing; at ten he could compose poetry.
idiomatic: As a boy the Emperor delighted in letters and brushwork; by ten he could write verse.

literal: Once grown, he mastered archery, understood music, and loved painting.
idiomatic: When he came of age he excelled at archery, knew music, and took pleasure in painting.

literal: In the second year of Qianheng he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
idiomatic: In the second year of Qianheng he received the title Prince of Liang.

literal: In the first year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on wuwu day the new moon, because the late emperor's body lay in state, audience was not held.
idiomatic: In the first year of Tonghe, on the wuwu new moon of the first spring month, with the late emperor's coffin still in state, the court held no audience.

literal: On yichou day, following the testamentary edict, the late emperor's younger half-brother Zhimu was summoned before the Zaitu Hall and re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ning.
idiomatic: On yichou day, in accordance with the testamentary edict, the late emperor's younger half-brother Zhimu was called before the Zaitu Hall and restored as Prince of Ning.

literal: Chancellor Shifang, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, and others were granted additional favor.
idiomatic: Chancellor Shifang, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, and others received added honors.

literal: On bingyin day Prince of Jing Daoyin fell ill; an edict dispatched envoys to inquire after his health.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Prince of Jing Daoyin took ill, and an edict sent envoys to inquire after him.

literal: That same day the Empress Dowager visited his residence to see him.
idiomatic: That same day the Empress Dowager went in person to his residence to visit him.

literal: On wuchen day Yelü Zhangwa, military commissioner of the Wuyu Wuguli division, was made co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Yelü Zhangwa, military commissioner of the Wuyu Wuguli division, was appointed co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.

literal: On jiaxu day Prince of Jing Daoyin died; court was suspended three days; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Jin; envoys were sent to comfort his household.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Prince of Jing Daoyin died; court mourning lasted three days; he was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Jin, and envoys were sent to comfort his family.

literal: On bingzi day yuyue Xiuge was made Nanjing regent and given the seal and cord of Southern Route camp commander-in-chief to oversee border affairs; Bohai tamasa Jieli, having received the late emperor's great favor, asked to be buried alive with him; an edict refused but granted gifts to honor him.
idiomatic: On bingzi day yuyue Xiuge was appointed Nanjing regent and given the seal and cord of Southern Route camp commander-in-chief to oversee the frontier; Bohai tamasa Jieli, who had received the late emperor's great kindness, begged to follow him in death; the court refused but rewarded him with gifts.

literal: On wuyin day envoys were sent with medicinal broth to yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, circuit military commissioner Pide, and others.
idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with medicinal broth for yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, circuit military commissioner Pide, and others.

literal: Ken Du was ordered to carry and post Xiuge's proclamation on alighting from the carriage, to instruct the people of Yan.
idiomatic: Ken Du was ordered to carry and post Xiuge's proclamation on alighting from his carriage, to reassure the people of Yan.

literal: On xinsi day Susa presented Zubu captives.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Susa presented prisoners taken from the Zubu.

literal: On renwu day Anji, prefect of Zhuo, reported that Song was building fortifications north of the Yellow River; an edict ordered regent yuyue Xiuge to obstruct it and not let the work be completed.
idiomatic: On renwu day Anji, prefect of Zhuo, reported that Song was building fortifications north of the Yellow River; an edict ordered regent yuyue Xiuge to thwart the work and prevent its completion.

literal: Consort Zhao, Princess Hugudian, Xi King Chouning, Chancellor Anning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, tihu Qulie, Prince of Wu Shao, Prince of Ning Zhimei, members of the horizontal tents, imperial in-laws, Khitan, and Han officials all contributed toward the mausoleum expenses.
idiomatic: Consort Zhao, Princess Hugudian, Xi King Chouning, Chancellor Anning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, tihu Qulie, Prince of Wu Shao, Prince of Ning Zhimei, members of the horizontal tents, imperial in-laws, Khitan, and Han officials all contributed to the mausoleum expenses.

literal: On guiwei day the Princess of Qi led the inner and outer titled ladies in presenting gifts likewise.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the Princess of Qi led the inner and outer titled ladies in presenting gifts in the same manner.

literal: On jiawu day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Derang reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had invaded the border; troops were sent and defeated them.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Derang reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had raided the frontier; troops were dispatched and routed them.

literal: On yiyou day, because Susa had defeated the Zubu, an edict praised him;
idiomatic: On yiyou day, because Susa had broken the Zubu, an edict commended him;

literal: he was also instructed to join Dahan in campaigning against the Tangut divisions.
idiomatic: he was also ordered to join Dahan in campaigning against the Tangut divisions.

literal: On dinghai day Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Shifang, being old, requested to be relieved of his concurrent post; an edict refused.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Shifang, citing age, asked to be relieved of his concurrent office; the court refused.

literal: In the second month, on the wuzi new moon, officials and soldiers and civilians everywhere were forbidden to gather in crowds for private talk or to travel at night in violation of curfew; violators would be punished.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the second month, officials, soldiers, and civilians everywhere were forbidden to gather in crowds for private talk or to travel at night in violation of curfew; offenders would be punished.

literal: On jichou day Nanjing reported that Song was stockpiling grain on the border and that the Song ruler would soon go to Mount Tai; an edict ordered Xiuge to make strict preparations.
idiomatic: On jichou day Nanjing reported that Song was stockpiling grain on the frontier and that the Song emperor would soon visit Mount Tai; an edict ordered Xiuge to prepare defenses strictly.

literal: On jiawu day Emperor Jingzong was buried at Qian Mausoleum; the close attendants Lang and the wine-serving entertainer Dalu were buried alive with him.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Emperor Jingzong was interred at Qian Mausoleum; the close attendants Lang and the wine-serving entertainer Dalu were buried alive with him.

literal: The Emperor and the Empress Dowager each wrote a letter and attached it to the late emperor's coffin.
idiomatic: The Emperor and the Empress Dowager each wrote a letter and placed it with the late emperor's coffin.

literal: On bingshen day the Empress Dowager went to the mausoleum to offer sacrifice; she ordered portraits of close ministers painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall and granted the mausoleum workers gifts in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the Empress Dowager went to the mausoleum to offer sacrifice; she ordered portraits of close ministers painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall and rewarded the mausoleum workers according to rank.

literal: On gengzi day the late emperor's personal effects were granted to the imperial clan and close ministers.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the late emperor's personal effects were distributed to the imperial clan and close ministers.

literal: On xinchou day Nanjing circuit military commissioner Yelü Shanbu reported that more than seventy Song border villages had come over; an edict ordered them settled and cared for.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Nanjing circuit military commissioner Yelü Shanbu reported that more than seventy Song border villages had submitted; an edict ordered them settled and cared for.

literal: On yisi day the Imperial Portrait Hall was renamed the Jade Hall, and Wine Valley was renamed Sacred Valley.
idiomatic: On yisi day the court renamed the Imperial Portrait Hall the Jade Hall and Wine Valley the Sacred Valley.

literal: Susa reported victory in the campaign against the Tangut; envoys were sent to comfort and reward the troops.
idiomatic: Susa reported victory over the Tangut; envoys were dispatched to comfort and reward the troops.

literal: On wushen day tihu Huage was made Northern Court Great King, and Jieling was made Southern Prime Minister.
idiomatic: On wushen day tihu Huage was appointed Northern Court Great King, and Jieling was made Southern Prime Minister.

literal: On xinhai day the court visited Sacred Mountain and then paid respects at the three mausoleums.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the court visited Sacred Mountain and then paid respects at the three imperial tombs.

literal: On jiayin day the imperial daughter Princess Changshou was given in marriage to Wuliu, son of imperial in-law and chancellor Xiao Poxiang.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Princess Changshou was married to Wuliu, son of imperial in-law and chancellor Xiao Poxiang.

literal: In the third month, on wuwu day, Tiande Army Military Commissioner Tuila and his son died in battle; his younger brother Nieli succeeded to the title.
idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu day, Tiande Army Military Commissioner Tuila and his son were killed in battle; his younger brother Nieli inherited the post.

literal: On jiwei day the court halted at Solitary Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the court encamped at Solitary Mountain.

literal: Envoys were dispatched to reward the meritorious officers and soldiers of the southwest.
idiomatic: Envoys were sent to reward the meritorious officers and soldiers on the southwest frontier.

literal: On xinyou day grand-father's tent Grand Guardian Yelü Heluning was made tihu.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Yelü Heluning of the grand-father's tent was appointed tihu.

literal: On jiazi day the court halted at the Pingdian ford of the Liao River.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court made camp at the Pingdian ford of the Liao River.

literal: On xinsi day imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was made Liaoxing Army military commissioner and also granted the title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Brightness and Aiding Governance.
idiomatic: On xinsi day imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was appointed Liaoxing Army military commissioner and granted the title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Brightness and Aiding Governance.

literal: On renwu day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on the bingxu new moon, the court visited the Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court visited the Eastern Capital.

literal: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Mojie was additionally made Palace Attendant and appointed Eastern Capital regent.
idiomatic: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Mojie was also made Palace Attendant and appointed regent of the Eastern Capital.

literal: On gengyin day the court paid respects at Taizu Temple.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court visited Taizu Temple in homage.

literal: On guisi day an edict granted gifts to titled ladies living in widowhood.
idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered gifts granted to titled ladies living in widowhood.

literal: On bingshen day the court traveled south.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor traveled south.

literal: On xinchou day the court paid respects at the three mausoleums and distributed the goods presented from the Eastern Capital among the mausoleum officials.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the court paid respects at the three mausoleums and distributed the goods sent from the Eastern Capital among the tomb officials.

literal: An edict was again issued granting Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan a sword; those who disobeyed orders could be summarily executed.
idiomatic: An edict again granted Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan a sword, authorizing him to execute on the spot anyone who disobeyed orders.

literal: On renyin day sacrifice was offered at the Ningshen Hall.
idiomatic: On renyin day the court offered sacrifice at the Ningshen Hall.

literal: On guimao day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court visited Qian Mausoleum in homage.

literal: On yisi day envoys were sent with wine and dried meat to sacrifice at the tomb of co-chancellor Yelü Heyang.
idiomatic: On yisi day envoys were sent with wine and dried meat to offer sacrifice at the tomb of co-chancellor Yelü Heyang.

literal: On gengxu day the court visited the residence of Lady Wuguli; after paying respects to Taizu's portrait, it visited Princess Hugudian's residence for a banquet and granted gifts very generously.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the court visited Lady Wuguli's residence; after paying respects to Taizu's portrait, it went to Princess Hugudian's residence for a banquet and bestowed lavish gifts.

literal: On renzi day the ministers, because the Empress Dowager would participate in government, said she ought to receive an honorific title and asked that the relevant offices be ordered to draft the investiture rite in detail.
idiomatic: On renzi day the ministers, because the Empress Dowager would share in government, argued that she should receive an honorific title and asked the relevant offices to draft the investiture rites in detail.

literal: An edict instructed the Commissioner of Military Affairs to notify frontier commanders that on the day of the rite they should send only their sons to submit congratulatory memorials, lest border defense be neglected.
idiomatic: An edict instructed the Commissioner of Military Affairs to notify frontier commanders that on the day of the rite they should send only their sons with congratulatory memorials, lest border defenses suffer.

literal: The Commissioner of Military Affairs requested an edict ordering Northern Prime Minister Pide to translate the legal texts submitted from Nanjing; this was approved.
idiomatic: The Commissioner of Military Affairs asked that an edict order Northern Prime Minister Pide to translate the legal texts submitted from Nanjing; the request was granted.

literal: The court then went to Huizhou.
idiomatic: The court then proceeded to Huizhou.

literal: Yelü Qinglang was made Xinzhou military commissioner.
idiomatic: Yelü Qinglang was appointed Xinzhou military commissioner.

literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen new moon, imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning, because the Empress Dowager was celebrating her birthday, asked to return to his parents' home to perform the rite; the Princess of Qi, titled ladies, and the officials each presented gifts.
idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month, imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning, because the Empress Dowager was celebrating her birthday, asked to return to his parents' home to perform the rite; the Princess of Qi, titled ladies, and officials each presented gifts.

literal: A banquet was held and gifts were granted in differing amounts to the elders of the imperial in-law tents.
idiomatic: A banquet was held and the elders of the imperial in-law tents were rewarded with gifts according to rank.

literal: On renxu day the Southwest Route pacification commissioner requested additional troops to campaign against the Western Turkic divisions; an edict ordered Northern Court Prince Yelü Pununing to lead the Dibi and Dielie divisions to join him.
idiomatic: On renxu day the Southwest Route pacification commissioner asked for reinforcements against the Western Turkic divisions; an edict ordered Northern Court Prince Yelü Pununing to march with the Dibi and Dielie divisions to his aid.

literal: On guihai day, because yuyue Xiuge had overused clerks in the Southern Court, an edict ordered the Southern Court Great King not to follow the same practice.
idiomatic: On guihai day, because yuyue Xiuge had overused clerks in the Southern Court, an edict warned the Southern Court Great King not to follow suit.

literal: On gengwu day Yelü Shanbu recruited those who had fled into Song and recovered more than a thousand households for the state; an edict ordered them settled and comforted.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Yelü Shanbu recruited fugitives who had entered Song and brought back more than a thousand households; an edict ordered them settled and reassured.

literal: On xinwei day the court halted at Yongzhou and sacrificed at the tomb of Prince Yaoshinü.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the court encamped at Yongzhou and offered sacrifice at the tomb of Prince Yaoshinü.

literal: On yihai day an edict ordered close ministers to discuss the Empress Dowager's honorific investiture rite; Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Dedu drafted a plan based on the precedent of the Later Han empress dowager's regency and submitted it.
idiomatic: On yihai day an edict ordered close ministers to discuss the Empress Dowager's honorific investiture; Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Dedu drafted a plan based on the Later Han precedent of empress dowager regency and submitted it.

literal: On bingzi day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On wuyin day the court visited Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Emperor went to Mount Muye.

literal: Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan reported that he had recently sent zhaila Balaige to summon the Tangut divisions and very many had come; an edict praised him.
idiomatic: Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan reported that he had recently sent zhaila Balaige to summon the Tangut divisions and a great many had come; an edict commended him.

literal: In the sixth month, on the yiyou new moon, an edict ordered the relevant offices that on the day the Empress Dowager was invested, officials of third rank and above were to receive court robes, and those below third rank were to wear the great willow-shooting robes.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth month an edict ordered that on the day of the Empress Dowager's investiture, officials of third rank and above were to receive court robes and those below third rank the great willow-shooting robes.

literal: The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains including the son of yilijin Zuiyin were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to watch their sincerity and keep border defenses strict.
idiomatic: The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains including the son of yilijin Zuiyin were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to test their sincerity and maintain strict border defenses.

literal: On bingxu day the court returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the court came back to the Supreme Capital.

literal: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was at odds with the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was then sent out as Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was estranged from the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was sent out as Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

literal: On xinmao day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

literal: On jiawu day the Emperor led the ministers in submitting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Empress Dowager Chengtian; the ministers submitted to the Emperor the honorific title Emperor Tianfu; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Tonghe.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor led the ministers in honoring the Empress Dowager as Empress Dowager Chengtian; the ministers honored the Emperor as Emperor Tianfu; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Tonghe.

literal: On dingwei day favor was extended throughout court and country; civil and military officials each advanced one rank in nobility.
idiomatic: On dingwei day favor was extended throughout court and country; civil and military officials each advanced one step in rank.

literal: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was appointed to hold the post of Minister of Works.
idiomatic: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was ordered to serve as Minister of Works.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the jiayin new moon, the Empress Dowager assumed governance.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager began to govern.

literal: On yimao day the Emperor personally reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor personally reviewed the prisoners.

literal: Prince and Minister of Works Louguo was caned twenty strokes for claiming illness and failing to attend the mausoleum rites.
idiomatic: Prince and Minister of Works Louguo was flogged twenty strokes for feigning illness and failing to attend the mausoleum rites.

literal: On xinyou day the rebirth rite was performed.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the court performed the rebirth rite.

literal: On guiyou day Linhuang prefect Gun presented food and drink.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Linhuang prefect Gun brought food and drink for the court.

literal: The Emperor and the princes divided into teams and played cuju.
idiomatic: The Emperor and the princes formed teams and played cuju.

literal: On bingzi day Han Derang sent xiangwen zhamas to break the Tangut and sent the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Han Derang sent xiangwen zhamas to defeat the Tangut and reported the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.

literal: On xinsi day meritorious officers and soldiers of the southwest were rewarded.
idiomatic: On xinsi day meritorious officers and soldiers on the southwest frontier were rewarded.

literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi day, the Emperor toured west.
idiomatic: On wuzi day in the eighth month the Emperor toured west.

literal: On jichou day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jichou day the court visited the ancestral mausoleum in homage.

literal: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager sacrificed at the tomb of Prince of Chu Xiao Siwen.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager offered sacrifice at the tomb of Prince of Chu Xiao Siwen.

literal: On guisi day the Emperor and the Empress Dowager paid respects at Huai Mausoleum and then visited Huaizhou.
idiomatic: On guisi day the Emperor and the Empress Dowager visited Huai Mausoleum in homage and then went to Huaizhou.

literal: On jiawu day the Emperor and Xiezhen exchanged bows, arrows, saddles, and horses before the Empress Dowager and pledged friendship.
idiomatic: On jiawu day before the Empress Dowager the Emperor and Xiezhen exchanged bows, arrows, saddles, and horses and swore friendship.

literal: On jihai day the court hunted at Red Mountain; envoys were sent to present bear fat and dried venison at the Ningshen Hall of Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jihai day the court hunted at Red Mountain and sent envoys to offer bear fat and dried venison at the Ningshen Hall of Qian Mausoleum.

literal: Because Chief Councillor Sun Zhen had no son, an edict made imperial in-law Xiao Weng's tent langjun Taowei his heir.
idiomatic: Because Chief Councillor Sun Zhen had no son, an edict made Taowei, a langjun of imperial in-law Xiao Weng's tent, his heir.

literal: On yisi day an edict ordered yuyue Xiuge to oversee Yuancheng.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict put yuyue Xiuge in charge of Yuancheng.

literal: On renzi day Han Derang memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; an edict approved it;
idiomatic: On renzi day Han Derang memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; the court approved;

literal: several thousand troops of a separate division were also dispatched to assist.
idiomatic: several thousand troops from a separate division were also dispatched to assist.

literal: In the ninth month, on the guichou new moon, because the Eastern Capital and Pingzhou suffered drought and locusts, an edict ordered relief.
idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the ninth month, because the Eastern Capital and Pingzhou suffered drought and locusts, an edict ordered relief.

literal: On yimao day the court paid respects at the Yongxing, Changning, and Dunmu palaces.
idiomatic: On yimao day the court visited the Yongxing, Changning, and Dunmu palaces in homage.

literal: On bingchen day the Nanjing regent reported that autumn rains had damaged the crops and requested a temporary suspension of frontier tolls to allow grain trade with Shanxi; this was approved.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the Nanjing regent reported that autumn rains had ruined the harvest and asked that frontier tolls be suspended temporarily to allow grain trade with Shanxi; the request was granted.

literal: On gengshen day the court paid respects at the temple of Emperor Xuanjian.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court visited the temple of Emperor Xuanjian in homage.

literal: On xinyou day the court visited Zuzhou and paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the court went to Zuzhou and paid homage at the ancestral mausoleum.
